
# Generated Files Summary

## Data Files
1. comprehensive_results_summary.csv - Complete performance metrics comparison
2. system_parameters.csv - Power system configuration parameters
3. optimized_controller_parameters.csv - ABC-optimized PID gains
4. abc_optimization_convergence.csv - Optimization convergence history

## Visualization Files
1. fuzzy_membership_functions.png - Input/output membership function plots
2. abc_convergence.png - ABC algorithm convergence curve
3. frequency_response_*.png - Frequency deviation plots for each test case
4. tie_line_power_*.png - Tie-line power exchange plots
5. performance_metrics_comparison.png - Controller performance comparison
6. system_states_ABC-Fuzzy-PID_*.png - Detailed system state evolution

## Documentation Files
1. technical_report.txt - Comprehensive technical analysis
2. code_documentation.txt - Implementation details and usage guide
3. file_summary.txt - This file listing all outputs

## Usage Notes
- All plots are saved in high resolution (300 DPI) PNG format
- CSV files can be opened in Excel or imported into other analysis tools
- Text files contain detailed technical information and implementation guides
